title: Lock and Unlock
statement: The task is to make all n elements of an array equal (n up to 2·10^5, |a_i| up to 10^9) using operations that lock k elements at cost k and shift every unlocked element by ±1, minimising cost, then operations. Since shifting the unlocked elements equals shifting the locked ones the opposite way, cost is the sum of absolute deviations from the median and the count is max minus min.
